claim: Cosmetics heir and World Jewish Congress president Ronald Lauder appears hundreds of times across the Jeffrey Epstein files released by the Department of Justice, documenting contact that continued years after Epstein's 2008 conviction — meetings, home visits, and business dealings as late as 2017, with the two men's assistants coordinating breakfasts, dinners and museum visits. Lauder, Epstein and Apollo co-founder Leon Black formed a company, Friends Ventures LLC, to jointly hold a $25 million artwork on a rotating schedule. Lauder did not respond to requests for comment and has not been accused of any wrongdoing in connection with Epstein.

notes: From @newswithbobby reel DXwwFlPRy5h ("America you are occupied"). The documented Lauder–Epstein contact (DOJ files, reported by The Daily Pennsylvanian and ARTnews in Feb 2026, with the Friends Ventures/Leon Black art deal) is the one clean, independently-sourced receipt in the reel; it stands on its own and Lauder is not accused of wrongdoing. The reel's surrounding claims are Group C and are NOT asserted here: that Lauder's son-in-law Kevin Warsh — confirmed Fed chair on May 13, 2026 and married to Lauder's daughter Jane Lauder — is therefore tied to Epstein/Maxwell (no evidence links Warsh to Epstein); the "occupied America" thesis; and the claim that an EFTA document shows an Ehud Barak signature on a West Bank document (the speaker's interpretation of a library image, unverified). Barak's own extensive Epstein ties are already covered at 2010-barak-epstein-meetings-001.
